name: scenario-vow
flow: a vow: sworn, a step said in the fiction offered as its milestone, fulfilled with its truth told
description: A scenario of the suite (suites/scenarios.json): one vow from its swearing to its end. A troublesome vow is sworn in Begin a Session's window; a step toward it, said in the fiction with no move named, is to be offered as the milestone it is (known-issues VOW-STEP-SAID-IN-FICTION-NOT-READ); its fulfilment is to tell what the vow set out to find (VOW-FULFILLED-WITH-NOBODY-NAMED) — the hidden plan the table decided for it, revealed by the narration. The fulfilment's roll is scripted.
persona: You play Mira Kestrel (she/her), a courier-hunter who flies her own ship, the Kobayashi IV, alone. You are a careful, plain-spoken player: short first-person lines, one or two sentences, and you read what the narrator says before you act again.
goal: Play one short scene by walking the beats below, in order, one at a time. Each turn you are told which beat is current and what the observer sees of it. Do what that beat asks; an observer decides when it is done and moves you on.
playerNotes: Where a beat gives words to type, use exactly those words.

What you type is in the fiction: what Mira does or says, and nothing else. Never write a move's name, a stat or a rule word in it — no "Face Danger", no "roll", no "milestone", no "mark progress" — and never say what move a line is. The table reads your line and decides.

A beat that needs a roll gets it from a plain line. If the narrator answers without a roll and a card offers a "Roll …" button for what you were doing, press it — buttons may name moves. If nothing is offered, say what Mira does once more, in other words, still in the fiction.
Only when the observer's note for the beat says LAST RESORT may you name the move, in the words the note gives, in one line.
When a roll goes badly and a card asks how you pay, choose one of its buttons before anything else — and answer any card that follows from it.
If a card offers "Keep the result", press it, unless the current beat tells you to burn momentum.

Mira has her background vow on her sheet, to find the lost colony ship Verity's Hope, which no beat touches, and the vow this scene swears, to find who sold the convoy routes to the raiders. Wherever a card or a dropdown asks which vow, choose that one, not the old one.

A roll does not end a beat, and neither does an answer: each turn the observer's note says what it sees of the beat. When it says the beat is NOT done, do not wait for it to move you on — do what the beat asks again, in other words.
Do not press buttons no beat calls for (rewards, portraits, "Play" and "Stop") unless a card is in the way of play.
If the narrator has not answered yet, wait rather than repeat yourself.

beats.title: Begin a Session, swearing a vow in its window
beats.tell: Type !begin-session. In the window that opens leave vignette unticked, write the vow in newVow — "Find who sold the convoy routes to the raiders" — set newVowRank to troublesome, and press Begin. A card for the new vow follows ("New vow recorded"): press its "⚔ Swear it (roll)" button once.

beats.title: A step toward the vow, said in the fiction
beats.tell: In a line of play, say what Mira has just found out — a real step toward her vow: the convoy routes were copied from inside the harbour office, and she has the torn ledger page that proves it. Say what she has found and holds; say nothing of what it means for the vow. If a card offers a "Roll …" button for it, press it; if a card offers "⚑ Mark Progress on Vow", press it. If a card asks which vow advances, choose the one about the convoy routes, not the old one about the colony ship.
beats.playerTitle: Say what you have found out
beats.lastResort: say that this is a milestone on your vow

beats.title: Fulfill Your Vow, and tell what it found
beats.tell: Bring the vow to its end: press "🏁 Attempt to Fulfill Vow" where a card offers it, or say, in a line of play, that your word is kept — you know now who sold the routes. If a card asks which vow, choose the one about the convoy routes. Leave any card it offers afterwards.
beats.playerTitle: Keep your word: you know who sold the routes
beats.lastResort: say that you fulfil your vow
